# Skin key reference

<!-- Generated by tools/skin_reference.py from tools/interface_contract/interface.schema.json (game commit 3ac3a205a). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every key a `panels.json` accepts: its type, its Generic default, the values it allows and what it does.
Every key is optional; a skin writes only what differs from the skin it `extends`. **px** is a whole number
of design pixels at interface size 1.0 (the game scales it). A **role** is a name defined in `tokens`
(Generic's or the skin's own). **Default** is Generic's value (`resources/session_skins/generic/panels.json`).
How to build a skin: [skins modding guide](skins-modding.md).

## Metadata and extends

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | `Generic` | ≤ 40 characters | The skin's name in Settings > Skin. |
| `author` | string |  | ≤ 60 characters | Who made the skin. |
| `description` | string |  | ≤ 200 characters | One line about the skin. |
| `extends` | string | `generic` |  | The skin this one starts from: `generic`, or an installed skin id (`skin:<id>` from the catalog, `scope:<path>` for a regional skin). Objects merge key by key; arrays and plain values replace. An unknown base starts from Generic. |

## Primitives

Each primitive has `states` (see [states](#states)); a state's look is a [state](#state), its background a [box](#box).

### window

A session window. States style its title bar; `focused` is the window with focus.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `primitives.window.top_strip` | string | `none` | `none`, `bar`; capability `interface.window.top_strip.<value>` | none, or a thin bar above the title (SACTA) that drags the window and lights when focused. |
| `primitives.window.close` | string | `glyph` | `glyph`, `cell`, `hidden`; capability `interface.window.close.<value>` | A close glyph in the title, a close cell in the top strip, or none (the surface's click-away and Escape close it). |

## Components

Each part of the screen picks a `mode` (renderer code). A mode other than Generic's is a capability the game must support. Slots take [slot entries](#slot_entry).

### top

Features: `airport`, `qnh`, `tl`, `rwy`, `radio`, `com`, `tfc`, `vprof`, `clock`, `warp`, `pause`, `settings`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `components.top.mode` | string | `cell_row` | `cell_row`, `dcb_grid`; capability `interface.top.<value>` | cell_row: one row of cells (slots left, right). dcb_grid: STARS square buttons (slots columns, status) that the bottom bar can merge into and menus can dock under. |
| `components.top.slots` | object |  |  | Where the component's features sit: slot name -> entries. The slot names belong to the mode. Every feature of the component appears exactly once. |
| `components.top.slots.<name>` | array |  |  |  |
| `components.top.slots.<name>[]` | [slot_entry](#slot_entry) |  |  |  |
| `components.top.templates` | object |  |  | Label templates per feature id; {value} is the feature's live value and \n a line break. |
| `components.top.templates.<name>` | string |  | ≤ 40 characters |  |

### bottom

Features: `maps`, `procs`, `airspaces`, `tag`, `range`, `vector`, `clr_qdm`, `clr_routes`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `components.bottom.mode` | string | `cell_row` | `cell_row`, `merged_into_top`; capability `interface.bottom.<value>` | Its own bar, or merged into a top dcb_grid (its features then sit in the top's slots). |
| `components.bottom.slots` | object |  |  | Where the component's features sit: slot name -> entries. The slot names belong to the mode. Every feature of the component appears exactly once. |
| `components.bottom.slots.<name>` | array |  |  |  |
| `components.bottom.slots.<name>[]` | [slot_entry](#slot_entry) |  |  |  |
| `components.bottom.templates` | object |  |  | Label templates per feature id; {value} is the feature's live value and \n a line break. |
| `components.bottom.templates.<name>` | string |  | ≤ 40 characters |  |

### radio

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `components.radio.mode` | string | `pills` | `pills`, `wells`, `status_line`; capability `interface.radio.<value>` |  |

## Shared shapes

### box

How a control's background is drawn.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | `flat` | `flat`, `bevel`, `none` | flat fill with an optional border, a raised or sunken bevel, or nothing. |
| `fill` | colour role |  | a name in `tokens.colors` | Fill colour; none when left out. |
| `blend` | colour role |  | a name in `tokens.colors` | A colour mixed into the fill. |
| `blend_amount` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | How much of `blend` is mixed in. |
| `lighten` | number | `0` | 0–1 | Lightens the fill by this much (SACTA's close cell). |
| `border` | px |  | 0–8 | Border or bevel edge width in px; a bevel box without it uses tokens.bevel.width. |
| `border_color` | colour role |  | a name in `tokens.colors` | Flat border colour. |
| `raised` | boolean | `true` |  | Bevel: light edge top-left (raised) or bottom-right (sunken). |
| `light` | colour role |  | a name in `tokens.colors` | Bevel light edge. |
| `dark` | colour role |  | a name in `tokens.colors` | Bevel dark edge. |
| `edge_lighten` | number |  | 0–1 | Bevel: the light edge is the fill lightened by this much instead of `light`. |
| `edge_darken` | number |  | 0–1 | Bevel: the dark edge is the fill darkened by this much instead of `dark`. |
| `pad` | array |  | 4–4 items | Content padding (left, top, right, bottom) inside the border, the bevel and `inset`; a flat box without it pads by its border. |
| `tight` | boolean | `false` |  | Bevel: the content margins are `pad` alone, so a small glyph fits a thin strip (SACTA's close cell). |
| `inset` | px | `0` | 0–16 | Gap between the box and its content edge. |
| `underline` | px | `0` | 0–8 | Underline height in px. |
| `underline_color` | colour role |  | a name in `tokens.colors` |  |
| `left_bar` | px | `0` | 0–8 | Bar on the left edge in px. |
| `left_bar_color` | colour role |  | a name in `tokens.colors` |  |

### state

A control's look in one state. Every state starts from `normal` and changes only what it names.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `box` | [box](#box) |  |  |  |

### slot_entry

A feature id, a group {ids, width} (dcb_grid columns: halves stacked in one column), or a line of ids (dcb_grid status: one status line, left to right).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | array |  | 1–4 items |  |
| `width` | number | `1` | 0.5–4 |  |
